    prev = [None] * n
    dist[start] = 0

        if cur_dist != dist[u]:

                prev[v] = u

        return [], -1

    path = []

        node = prev[node]
    path.reverse()

        (9,10):134
    }

    for (i, j), w in edges.items():
        dist[i][j] = w
        dist[j][i] = w

    # Held-Karp dynamic programming for shortest Hamiltonian cycle starting at 0
    start = 0
    dp = {}
    parent = {}

    for j in range(1, n):
        mask = 1 << (j - 1)
        dp[(mask, j)] = dist[start][j]
        parent[(mask, j)] = start

    for size in range(2, n):
        new_dp = {}
        for mask in range(1, 1 << (n - 1)):
            if mask.bit_count() != size:
                continue
            for j in range(1, n):
                if not (mask & (1 << (j - 1))):
                    continue
                prev_mask = mask ^ (1 << (j - 1))
                best = float('inf')
                best_k = None
                for k in range(1, n):
                    if not (prev_mask & (1 << (k - 1))):
                        continue
                    cand = dp[(prev_mask, k)] + dist[k][j]
                    if cand < best:
                        best = cand
                        best_k = k
                new_dp[(mask, j)] = best
                parent[(mask, j)] = best_k
        dp.update(new_dp)

    full_mask = (1 << (n - 1)) - 1
    best_tour = float('inf')
    end_city = None
    for j in range(1, n):
        cand = dp[(full_mask, j)] + dist[j][start]
        if cand < best_tour:
            best_tour = cand
            end_city = j

    # Reconstruct cycle
    route_rev = [end_city]
    mask = full_mask
    j = end_city
    while True:
        pj = parent[(mask, j)]
        if pj == start:
            break
        route_rev.append(pj)
        mask ^= 1 << (j - 1)
        j = pj

    route = [start] + list(reversed(route_rev))
    return route, int(best_tour)
